mapper.insert: INSERT INTO floor (name, code, create_time, create_by, remark) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE floor SET name = #{name}, code = #{code}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, code, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, remark FROM floor ORDER BY code ASC

SELECT f.id AS f_id, f.name AS f_name, f.code AS f_code, f.create_time AS f_create_time, f.update_time AS f_update_time, f.create_by AS f_create_by, f.update_by AS f_update_by, f.remark AS f_remark, r.id AS r_id, r.code AS r_code, r.sort AS r_sort, r.type_name AS r_type_name, r.floor_id AS r_floor_id, r.create_time AS r_create_time, r.is_deleted AS r_is_deleted, b.id AS b_id, b.bed_number AS b_bed_number, b.bed_status AS b_bed_status, b.sort AS b_sort, b.room_id AS b_room_id, b.create_time AS b_create_time, b.remark AS b_remark FROM floor f LEFT JOIN room r ON f.id = r.floor_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN bed b ON r.id = b.room_id ORDER BY f.code ASC, r.sort ASC, b.sort ASC

SELECT f.id AS f_id, f.name AS f_name, f.code AS f_code, f.create_time AS f_create_time, f.update_time AS f_update_time, f.create_by AS f_create_by, f.update_by AS f_update_by, f.remark AS f_remark, r.id AS r_id, r.code AS r_code, r.sort AS r_sort, r.type_name AS r_type_name, r.floor_id AS r_floor_id, r.create_time AS r_create_time, r.is_deleted AS r_is_deleted, b.id AS b_id, b.bed_number AS b_bed_number, b.bed_status AS b_bed_status, b.sort AS b_sort, b.room_id AS b_room_id, b.create_time AS b_create_time, b.remark AS b_remark FROM floor f INNER JOIN room r ON f.id = r.floor_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN bed b ON r.id = b.room_id AND b.bed_status = #{status} ORDER BY f.code ASC, r.sort ASC, b.sort ASC
